rows.falsifier: Statistically significant evidence that action-selection variance remains constant across diverse experiential trajectories.
rows.reason: Previous experimental variance measurements (exp-mem-pref-14) were inconclusive, necessitating a synthesis of existing experiential memory findings to progress on commitment commit-mem-pref-10.
rows.statement: Preference stability in autonomous agents is significantly influenced by path-dependent memory accumulation, even when scalarized reward signals appear static.

rows.falsifier: Demonstration that episodic trace retention alone is sufficient to produce functionally identical behavior across structurally distinct agent instances.
rows.reason: Advancing toward commitment commit-mem-id-01 by framing the theoretical distinction between continuity and identity as a prerequisite for metric definition.
rows.statement: Episodic trace retention acts as a necessary but insufficient condition for persistent identity in computational agents, which further requires integrative regulatory invariants.
